claim_addressed: High-SI heads and retrieval heads (Wu et al. 2024) are distinct populations, supporting SI infrastructure as a novel finding beyond retrieval-head taxonomy
outcome_summary: Jaccard < 0.1 and ρ <= -0.20 (active separation signal) in all models. SI heads and retrieval heads are empirically disjoint populations. Add to Result III: 'SI infrastructure heads are distinct from retrieval heads (Wu et al. 2024)'.
